working_on.feature: Enhanced Phase Prompt Template & Infinite Timeout Verification
working_on.task: Updated default prompt template to include web search guidance (search_web / read_url_content) and prevent direct DOM browser access. Verified infinite timeout (0 = infinite) flow and built VSIX.
working_on.notes: Prompt now strictly requires single file-based test, web search for best practices, prohibits direct browser DOM interaction, and signs off with 'Done skul9x.' to save tokens.

recent_changes.description: Updated defaultPromptTemplate and promptTemplate in config.ts and package.json with anti-DOM browser rule and web search guidelines; packaged VSIX.

decisions_made: Prevent AI from opening browser directly or manipulating DOM to avoid IDE collisions with DOM Bridge.
Enforce exactly one file-based test per phase for verification.
End prompt with 'Done skul9x.' to preserve zero-overhead transcript detection.
